meta.description: Sign in to write to the split-flap board on your television.

sign_in.title: Sign in
sign_in.lede: Your boards are where you left them, still showing whatever they were showing.

sign_up.title: Create an account
sign_up.lede: An account is what a television gets linked to. Make one and any screen in the house can become a board.

pairing.title: Link your television
pairing.lede: Those six flaps are the code on your screen. Finish here and the television links itself — there is nothing else to set up.
pairing.aside_body: The moment you are signed in, that television is added to your account and you land on its controller. Type there and the flaps turn.
pairing.aside_note: A code is good for five minutes. If the screen has moved on to a new one, scan it again.

tv.label: On your television
tv.flaps_label: The address {{address}}, set in split-flap letters
tv.body: Open the television's own browser and type the address above. That is the whole setup — the screen turns into a board and shows a code to scan.
tv.note: Any screen with a browser will do. Nothing to install on it, and nothing to install on your phone either.

locked_out.label: If you cannot get in
locked_out.body: There is no password reset yet — no page, no email, nothing behind a link — so there is no link here pretending otherwise. It is written down as owed.
locked_out.note: Nothing is lost while you are out. The boards and every message on them are untouched, and a television that is already linked keeps showing the last thing it was given until somebody signs in and changes it.

errors.invalid_credentials: That email and password don't match an account.
errors.email_taken: There is already an account with that email. Sign in instead.
errors.sign_in_failed: Could not sign in. Try again.
errors.sign_up_failed: Could not create the account. Try again.
